svg.title: Local first, then synchronize
svg.desc: Changes carry token operations, not editor snapshots. 1 · Client A: edit immediately: Apply locally → record own History → queue the change once. A model path is compiled to stable token operations. 2 · Transport → DocHub: Check actor sequence and operations; reject invalid whole changes. Accept → assign serverSeq → deliver accepted change. 3 · Client B: apply → project → render: Apply received operations → update model → update native editor. Dependencies must precede operations that reference them. 4 · Client A: confirmation: Remove confirmed pending work, not every queued change. Presence travels separately; authentication belongs to the application.
